fields.description:
Source: Kobi / Joyce doc feedback, 2026-08-10.

⚠️ OVERLAP: BUILD-49 (Deal display label formula field) is already Ready for Review. This card SUPERSEDES that spec — review together and close one.

Requested format for the Deal Name:

* With state: {StateCode}-{OperatorName}

* No state: {CountryCode}-{OperatorName}

* ALL CAPS; strip spaces and apostrophes from names.

⚠️ THREE THINGS TO RESOLVE BEFORE BUILD:

1\. CLICKABLE vs FORMULA. A formula field is not the record's Name and will not render as the record link in list views/lookups. To get a clickable auto-generated name you must WRITE to the Name field (record-triggered flow or Apex on insert/update), not use a formula. Confirm which is wanted.

2\. PARTNER SUFFIX CONFLICT. The written spec omits Partner, but the attached New Deal mockup says the name 'Auto-fills from Market + Operator + Partner while untouched', and the sample record is ON-BETMGM-C (-C = Catena). Existing convention (memory: Airtable naming) treats the suffix as the PARTNER code. Decide: include partner suffix or not.

3\. Q4 IN THE OPEN QUESTIONS DOC decided 'reps do not need to see Partner information throughout the interface' and explicitly rejected an Operator+Partner concatenation formula. If the partner suffix goes into the Deal Name, that decision is reversed — needs Wagertech confirmation.

Also per mockup: field is editable, with a 'Regenerate' link, and only auto-fills while untouched.
